Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
Technology and Telematics

2019 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 LT 4WD Extended Cab
45K Miles • 5.3L V8 • Z71 Off-Road • All-Star Edition • Homegrown Red Wing Chevrolet Truck

Why You'll Love It
Only 45,320 miles
5.3L V8 with 8-speed automatic
4WD with Z71 Off-Road Package
All-Star Edition
Trailering Package with Integrated Trailer Brake Controller
Heated Front Seats & Heated Steering Wheel
Backup Camera, Apple CarPlay & Android Auto
Bedliner, Tonneau Cover & All-Terrain Tires

From Our Used Car Manager Ryan Campion

This is one of those trucks that really checks the boxes. It's a 5.3 V8, 4WD Silverado with only 45,000 miles, and it has the Z71 and All-Star packages that make these trucks so desirable. It's also a Red Wing Chevrolet Homegrown vehicle we originally sold it and have handled the majority of its service over the years. That's a history I really like seeing on a used truck.

The Right-Sized Silverado

If you want the capability of a full-size Silverado without paying for a brand-new truck, this 2019 Silverado 1500 LT is worth a serious look.

Under the hood is Chevrolet's proven 5.3L V8, paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and 4WD. The Z71 Off-Road Package adds the equipment you want for Minnesota roads and weekend adventures, while the All-Star Edition brings additional capability and convenience. It also has the Trailering Package with an integrated trailer brake controller, making this a truck that's ready to work. The window sticker also shows the Z71 Off-Road & Protection Package, Bed Protection Package, Convenience Package II and LT Preferred Equipment Group.

Inside, you'll find heated front seats, a heated steering wheel, power driver's seat with lumbar, split-folding rear bench seating, multi-zone climate control, remote start and keyless entry/start. Technology includes a backup camera, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, Bluetooth, satellite radio, HD Radio and a Wi-Fi hotspot.

Outside, it's finished in Silver Ice Metallic and equipped with all-terrain tires, aluminum wheels, heated power mirrors, a bedliner and sliding rear window. The CARFAX also documents a tonneau cover and running boards installed at Red Wing Chevrolet shortly after it was originally sold.

A Truly Strong History

This truck is CARFAX Homegrown originally sold by Red Wing Chevrolet and serviced here throughout its history. It has 16 service records, two previous owners, and both owners were Minnesota-based.

Even better, the CARFAX reports no accidents or damage, no structural damage, no airbag deployment, no odometer issues, and no open recalls.

Recent history includes transmission service in January 2025, four new tires and an alignment in November 2025, and an oil change plus valve cover gasket replacement in December 2025.

The Red Wing Chevrolet Difference

This one has something you simply can't replicate with a truck from somewhere else: we know it.

We originally sold this Silverado new, and the CARFAX documents years of service right here at Red Wing Chevrolet. It's been maintained, serviced, and cared for locally, and now it's back where it started.

45,000 miles. 5.3L V8. 4WD. Z71. All-Star Edition. No accidents reported. Homegrown at Red Wing Chevrolet.

That's a pretty compelling combination.

- HEMI 5.7L V8 engine with multi-displacement technology and eTorque
- 4WD capability with 3.92 rear axle ratio and anti-spin differential
- Dual-pane panoramic sunroof
- Premium leather-trimmed bucket seats with heating and ventilation
- Uconnect 5 navigation system with 12.0" display and Apple CarPlay/Android Auto
- RamBox cargo management system with exterior 115V AC outlet
- Heated and power-adjustable steering wheel

- ParkView rear back-up camera

- Dual rear exhaust with bright tips
- Premium audio with SiriusXM 360L satellite radio

The 5.7-liter HEMI V8 paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission provides the performance you expect, delivering 17 city and 22 highway MPG. The 4WD system with anti-spin differential rear axle ensures traction in varied conditions, while the 3.92 rear axle ratio balances power and efficiency. Auto-leveling suspension technology keeps the ride composed whether carrying cargo or traveling empty.

Inside, the Limited trim showcases genuine wood accents throughout the dashboard, door panels, and console insert. Premium leather trimmed bucket seats feature heating and ventilation for both driver and passenger, with a heated rear seat for passenger comfort. The driver's seat includes memory presets, as do the exterior mirrors and pedals, allowing you to return to your preferred settings each time you enter the vehicle. The full-length premium floor console provides substantial storage with a genuine wood insert that reinforces the cab's upscale presentation.

Technology integration centers around the Uconnect 5 12.0-inch navigation display, which seamlessly accommodates Apple CarPlay and Android Auto for smartphone connectivity. SiriusXM 360L satellite radio with 10 speakers and active noise control creates an refined audio environment. The heated and power-adjustable steering wheel enhances cold-weather comfort while maintaining intuitive control access with steering wheel-mounted audio controls.

Exterior design reflects the Limited's standing, with body-color bumper group front and rear, chrome bumpers, chrome exterior mirrors with heating and courtesy lamps, and 20-inch aluminum painted and polished wheels. The dual-pane panoramic sunroof floods the cabin with natural light and enhances the sense of space. The RamBox cargo management system with exterior 115V AC outlet adds practical utility for job sites or recreational activities.

Safety and visibility receive equal attention through features including dual front and side impact airbags, overhead airbag, electronic stability control, traction control, and auto high-beam headlights with delay-off function. Front fog lights and rain-sensing wipers support confident operation in varying weather. The ParkView rear back-up camera provides clear rear visibility for parking and backing into challenging spaces.

This 2023 Ram 1500 Limited represents a substantial investment in capability, comfort, and reliability. We invite you to visit our showroom at 2747 N Military Hwy, Norfolk VA, across from the airport, to inspect this truck and discuss how it aligns with your needs and lifestyle.

Safety remains a priority with multiple airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, and advanced driver assistance features. The automatic high-beam system adapts to traffic conditions, and the brake assist system works in concert with ABS brakes to provide confidence in all driving situations.

With its purposeful design and well-appointed features, this Silverado 1500 LT offers the practical value truck buyers seek. The white exterior presents a clean, professional appearance, while the innovative technology keeps you informed and connected throughout your journey.

Contact us today to schedule a test drive and experience how this truck performs in real-world conditions.

Why BUY from Joyce Koons Honda? When you choose this Pacific Pewter Metallic 2023 honda Ridgeline RTL-E AWD with 28,573 miles, you are not just buying a used vehicle - you are investing in quality, reliability and peace of mind. Our clientele depend on us for Transparent Pricing, Convenience and, most importantly, Customer FIRST Service! No Accidents! One Owner! What this vehicle includes: Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.
Come on in to Joyce Koons Honda today at 10640 Automotive Drive Manassas VA 20109 or call 866-771-5815 to schedule a test drive!

This 2023 Nissan Frontier PRO-4X in Blue represents a capable truck designed for both daily driving and off-road exploration, combining rugged construction with modern convenience features that make every journey comfortable and secure.

- Fender Premium Audio System with 10 Speakers
- Off-Road Protection Package
- PRO Convenience Package
- Technology Package

The Intelligent Around View Monitor offers confidence during parking and low-speed maneuvers, while rear sonar and cross-traffic alert systems enhance visibility in challenging situations.

The interior combines comfort with practicality. Heated front seats and a heated steering wheel provide warmth during cold weather, while the power driver seat allows personalized positioning for long drives. The Fender audio system with 10 speakers and SiriusXM satellite radio keeps entertainment consistent throughout your commute or adventure.

Off-road readiness is evident with the PRO-4X Mud Flaps, Off-Road Style Step Rails, and spray-in bedliner protecting your truck's bed from the elements. The Blind Spot Warning and Lane Departure Warning System technologies work together with standard stability control to support confident driving in varied conditions.

Out here in Dalhart, a midsize truck still has to pull its weight. This 2021 Chevrolet Colorado ZR2 with the 3.6L V6 is built for folks who need something a little more nimble than a full size, but still tough enough to handle dirt roads, pasture work, and weekend trails without hesitation.

Under the hood, the 3.6L V6 puts out around 308 horsepower and 275 lb ft of torque, giving you strong, responsive power whether you are cruising down the highway or climbing through rough country. Paired with an 8 speed automatic and 4x4, it is quick when you need it and capable when the road turns into something a lot less forgiving.

What really sets the ZR2 apart is how it is built off road from the factory. You get a lifted suspension, wider stance, and Multimatic DSSV shocks that are made to handle rocks, ruts, and washboard roads without beating you up. Front and rear locking differentials come standard, so when traction gets limited, this truck keeps moving.

It is still practical where it counts too. With seating for five, a usable bed, and up to around 5,000 pounds of towing, it is more than capable of handling everyday jobs while being easier to maneuver around town or tight spaces. Inside, you have an easy to use infotainment system with Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and available WiFi, keeping you connected whether you are headed to Amarillo or out past the county line.

This Colorado ZR2 fits right into life out here. It is the kind of truck you can drive to work all week, take off road on the weekend, and never feel like you are in something too big or too soft for the job. If you are looking for a capable, aggressive midsize pickup that can handle real conditions without giving up comfort, this 2021 Colorado ZR2 V6 is ready to go.
